description: Any Google Sheets API batchUpdate: sheets (add, duplicate, delete, properties), rows and columns (insert, delete, move, resize, group, hide), cells (values with formats, repeat a format, borders, merges, copy/cut/paste, sort, find and replace, data validation, autofill), conditional formatting, filters and filter views, protected, named and banded ranges, charts, slicers, tables, pivots (as cell data) and developer metadata. One atomic batch, checked against the API's schema before anything is sent. Where a request takes a GridRange, GridCoordinate or DimensionRange, A1 naming the sheet works too ("Sheet1!A1:C10", "Sheet1!B3", "Sheet1!3:5" for rows, "Sheet1!B:D" for columns); a sheet added in the same batch is named by the sheetId set in its addSheet. Colours are {red, green, blue} from 0 to 1. Returns the replies that carry ids or counts, by request position.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

requests.description: sheets batchUpdate requests, applied in order, all or none: each an object with ONE request kind, e.g. {"repeatCell": {"range": "Sheet1!A1:D1", "cell": {"userEnteredFormat": {"textFormat": {"bold": true}}}, "fields": "userEnteredFormat.textFormat.bold"}}. Kinds: moveDimension, unmergeCells, deleteProtectedRange, addNamedRange, insertRange, clearBasicFilter, insertComment, updateCommentPost, updateConditionalFormatRule, updateDeveloperMetadata, deleteDeveloperMetadata, addConditionalFormatRule, addSlicer, findReplace, duplicateSheet, trimWhitespace, deleteConditionalFormatRule, duplicateFilterView, addDimensionGroup, sortRange, updateSheetProperties, deleteBanding, addBanding, addProtectedRange, copyPaste, deleteDataSource, addDataSource, updateProtectedRange, appendCells, autoResizeDimensions, updateNamedRange, deleteDuplicates, addSheet, updateCells, deleteFilterView, updateSpreadsheetProperties, autoFill, deleteTable, insertDimension, addCommentReply, updateBanding, cancelDataSourceRefresh, deleteEmbeddedObject, repeatCell, deleteRange, randomizeRange, createDeveloperMetadata, setBasicFilter, addChart, addTable, updateTable, setDataValidation, cutPaste, mergeCells, updateDataSource, updateDimensionProperties, deleteNamedRange, deleteDimensionGroup, updateEmbeddedObjectBorder, textToColumns, refreshDataSource, updateEmbeddedObjectPosition, deleteCommentReply, pasteData, deleteComment, updateFilterView, updateBorders, appendDimension, updateDimensionGroup, addFilterView, updateSlicerSpec, deleteDimension, updateChartSpec, deleteSheet. editors_api_reference names each kind's fields.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet's id, or its URL.
